Verify a randomisation list

check_rando_list.Rd

Checks a list made by createRandoList: unique randomisation numbers and patient IDs, and balance of arms within every complete block. It supports the pharmacist's verification of the final list (SOP 4.1.g).

Usage

check_rando_list(x)

# S3 method for class 'rando_check'
print(x, ...)

Arguments

x

A data frame or list of data frames from createRandoList(); for print, the result of check_rando_list().

...

Ignored.

Details

The last block of each stratum is reported separately because the list is cut at nPat and that block may be incomplete. The summary shows the block sizes, so it should only be shown to people allowed to see the list.

Value

An object of class "rando_check": a list with ok (logical), summary (one row per stratum) and problems (character).

Examples

x <- createRandoList(nPat = 30, seed = 1)
chk <- check_rando_list(x)
chk$ok
#> [1] TRUE
chk
#> Randomisation list check: OK
#> 
#>  stratum  n       arms n_blocks block_sizes complete_blocks_balanced
#>      HTD 30 A=14; B=16        7    4x4; 6x2                     TRUE
#>  last_block_balanced
#>                FALSE
#> 
#> Note: an unbalanced last block is expected when the list was cut at nPat.
